title: Stargate advances with 4.5 GW partnership with Oracle
summary: Oracle and OpenAI have entered an agreement to develop 4.5 gigawatts of additional Stargate data center capacity in the U.S. This investment will create new jobs, accelerate America’s reindustrialization, and help advance U.S. AI leadership. It also marks a major milestone for Stargate, OpenAI’s AI infrastructure platform and long-term vision to deliver the benefits of AI to everyone.
body: Oracle and OpenAI have entered an agreement to develop 4.5 gigawatts of additional Stargate data center capacity in the U.S. This investment will create new jobs, accelerate America’s reindustrialization, and help advance U.S. AI leadership. It also marks a major milestone for Stargate, OpenAI’s AI infrastructure platform and long-term vision to deliver the benefits of AI to everyone.
summaryZh: OpenAI与Oracle正式签署协议，计划共同开发4.5吉瓦（GW）的Stargate数据中心容量。该项目旨在通过大规模基础设施建设，支持OpenAI的长期AI愿景，并推动美国AI产业的算力布局。此次合作不仅是OpenAI在算力基础设施领域的重大里程碑，也反映了大型模型厂商对能源与计算资源的高度依赖与战略性投入，对未来AI算力供给格局具有深远影响。
